sources: Notional order of magnitude

aide._: Base of every catalogue unit. A unit inherits its parent's keys (herite_de) and may replace their values; each key carries its sentence here or in a parent.
aide.fidelite: Model fidelity level: notionnel (orders of magnitude), cinematique, point_masse (3 degrees of freedom) or 6ddl.
aide.sources: Origin of the values: public documents, books, or 'notional order of magnitude'. At least one entry.
aide.herite_de: Identifier of the parent unit, whose keys are taken before applying these.
aide.algos: Algorithms of the unit, by role: identifier in algos/ (or prive/algos/). A child unit only replaces the roles it names.
aide.pays: Country of inspiration (three-letter ISO 3166 code): sorting and badge colour only; name and values stay notional. null: generic unit.
aide.icone: Game icon of the unit (icones/<name>.svg), drawn on the map and in the palette; null: APP-6 symbology only.

global/allocation/densite_pistes.description: Each free aircraft is sent to the most worthwhile interception point: the track's strength divided by the aircraft already sent to the same place. The interception is the shortest delay at which the aircraft, flying straight, comes within range of the extrapolated track.
equations: |D + V t|² = (v t + r)², D = target − aircraft (ECEF)
score = strength / (1 + aircraft already assigned to the point's cell)
hypotheses: Straight-line extrapolation of tracks, unaware of their destination
global/allocation/densite_pistes.domaine_validite: Tracks at constant speed over the positioning time.

parametres.vitesse_mise_a_poste: Speed of the aircraft heading to its point.

global/allocation/plus_proche.description: Each free aircraft is sent to the current position of the track nearest to it, without extrapolating its route or taking the other aircraft into account.
equations: chosen track = argmin distance(aircraft, track)
point = current position of the track, at the aircraft's altitude
hypotheses: No anticipation: the aircraft aims at where the track is, not where it will be
Several aircraft may aim at the same track
global/allocation/plus_proche.domaine_validite: Teaching reference: slow or nearby tracks; to compare in a duel with density allocation.

parametres.vitesse_mise_a_poste: Speed of the aircraft heading to its point, for the announced delay.
parametres.altitude: Altitude of the group: the aimed point is taken at this altitude.

global/comportement/essaim_direct.description: Each group arrives from a random heading, in a tight wave, and flies straight at its target.
equations: start = point at rayon_apparition on the group's azimuth, offset sideways by U(−1 km, 1 km)
hypotheses: The group does not react to the defence
One heading per group, drawn uniformly over 360°
global/comportement/essaim_direct.domaine_validite: Saturating raids with no coordination between groups.

global/comportement/essaim_disperse.description: Each drone comes alone, from its own heading, with a departure drawn in a spread window.
equations: azimuth ~ U(0, 2π)
departure ~ U(0, spread)
global/comportement/essaim_disperse.domaine_validite: Diffuse harassment, probing for gaps in the defence.

global/comportement/essaim_fourmi.description: The whole swarm enters through the same narrow corridor, in a column, up to a burst point from which each drone heads for its target.
equations: entry = rayon_apparition + U(0, 4 km) on the common heading
burst at fourmi_eclatement_rayon from the centre, same lateral offset
global/comportement/essaim_fourmi.domaine_validite: Saturation of one sector then late dispersal, to hide numbers and targets.

parametres.fourmi_eclatement_rayon: Distance from the centre to the burst point (rouge.fourmi_eclatement_rayon_km).

global/comportement/plan_de_vol.description: The whole swarm follows the drawn waypoints, in a column of given width; after the last point, each drone heads for its target.
equations: start = first point, moved back by U(0, 4 km) along the first leg and offset by U(−l/2, l/2)
each next point keeps the same lateral offset, measured perpendicular to the leg leading to it
hypotheses: A single plan for the whole swarm
global/comportement/plan_de_vol.domaine_validite: Raids whose route is set by the user; with no plan, the swarm starts from the centre of the area.

global/detection/couverture_frontiere.description: Radars line the border: a drone is seen as soon as it is within the radar horizon of the area, measured on the ground from the centre.
equations: seen ⇔ geodesic distance to centre ≤ R_zone + min(d_h, max range)
hypotheses: Perfect radar within its coverage: no false alarm, no track loss
global/detection/couverture_frontiere.domaine_validite: Orders of magnitude of detection delay at low altitude; no terrain masking.
references: M. I. Skolnik, Introduction to Radar Systems, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill, 2001 — radar horizon

global/detection/sites_radar.description: Each radar is a site placed on the map; a drone is seen as soon as it enters the range of at least one of them (slant distance).
equations: d = min(√(2 k R_T) (√h_r + √h_c), max range), k = 4/3
seen ⇔ ∃ site: ‖P_drone − P_site‖² ≤ d² + (h_c − h_r)²  (ECEF positions)
hypotheses: Perfect radar within its range: no false alarm, no track loss
Detection shared by the whole defence (fully connected network)
global/detection/sites_radar.domaine_validite: Orders of magnitude of low-altitude coverage, sites at ground level.
references: M. I. Skolnik, Introduction to Radar Systems, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill, 2001 — radar horizon

parametres.sites_unites: Each site's own unit, if any (scenario: bleu.radar.sites[].unite); otherwise the common radar's.

global/mouvement/balistique.description: The vehicle follows the geodesic from start to target at constant ground speed, at the altitude of a parabola peaking halfway.
hypotheses: Symmetric parabola: no propulsion, no re-entry, no manoeuvre
global/mouvement/balistique.domaine_validite: Order of magnitude of altitude and flight time, to place detection and engagement; describes no real missile.

global/mouvement/croisiere_geodesique.description: The vehicle moves horizontally towards the next waypoint at constant altitude; the direction is recomputed at each step in the tangent plane, which follows the geodesic.
equations: Δφ = Δn / (M + h)
Δλ = Δe / ((N + h) cos φ)
global/mouvement/croisiere_geodesique.domaine_validite: Time steps short compared with the flight; turns negligible compared with distances (turn radius ≪ distances flown).
references: WGS84 radii of curvature: NIMA TR8350.2

global/pistage/cellules.description: Detected drones are grouped by 5 km cubic cells of geocentric space; each occupied cell becomes a track weighted by its strength.
equations: track = cell ⌊ECEF / 5 km⌋, strength = number of drones in the cell
hypotheses: Perfect association: the track carries the true position and velocity of one drone of the cell
global/pistage/cellules.domaine_validite: Planning of positioning; no measurement noise.

global/reaction/essaim_adaptatif.description: Through the swarm's mesh network, each drone learns where its fellows fall and where they hit: it leaves a target that kills for one that lets through, bypasses loss hotspots on its route and manoeuvres when a rocket targets it.
equations: ŝ_k = (F_k + 1) / (F_k + P_k + 2) (Laplace's rule of succession)
reassignment if F_k ≥ 1, ŝ_k − ŝ_c ≥ g and d_k ≤ (1 + a) d_c
y = R asin(sin(d_f / R) sin(α_f − α_w)); x = R acos(cos(d_f / R) / cos(y / R))
detour: azimuth α_f ∓ asin(ρ / d_f), distance √(d_f² − ρ²), ρ = 1.3 r_d
dodged Pk = Pk (1 − e); progress × (1 − v_e) during the rocket's flight
hypotheses: Connected mesh network: every loss and every hit is known to the whole swarm after a delay
The swarm does not see the defence, it only learns from its losses
Only hotspots around another target (fixed defended sites) are bypassed
Spherical approximation (R = 6,371 km) for the bypass decision only
Aggregated dodge: reduced Pk, with no guidance or manoeuvre law
global/reaction/essaim_adaptatif.domaine_validite: Raids where losses concentrate in a few hotspots (posts on targets, aircraft orbits); decisions at the scale of about ten kilometres.
references: Laplace, Essai philosophique sur les probabilités (1814), rule of succession

parametres.reaction_delai: Delay for a loss or a hit to spread through the swarm (rouge.reaction_delai_s).
parametres.reaction_seuil_pertes: Losses from which a hotspot is deemed defended (rouge.reaction_seuil_pertes).
parametres.reaction_allongement_max: Relative lengthening accepted for a reassignment or a detour (rouge.reaction_allongement_max).
parametres.reaction_seuil_gain: Estimated survival gain that triggers a reassignment (rouge.reaction_seuil_gain).
parametres.reaction_esquive_reduction: Fraction of the air Pk removed by the dodge (rouge.reaction_esquive_reduction).
parametres.reaction_esquive_perte_vitesse: Fraction of progress lost during the dodge (rouge.reaction_esquive_perte_vitesse).

global/tir/guidage_laser_semi_actif.description: The shooter designates the target until impact: it cannot fire again while designating.
equations: flight = busy time = designation time
hypotheses: Fixed designation time, whatever the distance
global/tir/guidage_laser_semi_actif.domaine_validite: Shots within effective range; clear weather (no cloud effect modelled).
references: Principle of semi-active laser guidance: P. Zarchan, Tactical and Strategic Missile Guidance, AIAA

global/tir/tire_et_oublie.description: The weapon guides itself after launch: the shooter may fire again after its rate interval, and the flight time is the distance over the mean speed.
equations: flight = distance / mean speed
busy time = rate interval
global/tir/tire_et_oublie.domaine_validite: IR or active radar seekers within their effective range.
references: P. Zarchan, Tactical and Strategic Missile Guidance, AIAA

global/tir_sol/cadence_par_passage.description: A drone crosses the post's bubble in range / speed seconds; the post must fit its engagements per pass within it.
equations: rate = (r_sol / v_drone) / engagements_par_passage
hypotheses: Fire at the nearest drone in the bubble
global/tir_sol/cadence_par_passage.domaine_validite: Short-range posts facing drones that fly over them.
